items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: Lee Hillard and James Jeter, and myself were the reed section back in those days.

ctx.x: Along with Jeeter. Yeah, see. Well, I'll tell you what happened. See, we had a boy -- a saxophone player named Lee Hillard. He was from Seguin, Texas. He died I guess about 10 years ago, I hear. He was a great alto

saxophonist, and he also played trumpet. Lee Hillard and James Jeter, and myself were the reed section back in those days. And my brother joined the band in the 30's. This was in '27. My brother joined the band -- my brother joined the band in -- oh, let's see, 1930 -- he joined the band in '32, I think it was. '31 or '32.
